name: mycrew-product
description: Layer 4/5 — the product plane: everything true about the whole product, above the sub-projects. /product-init founds it. /braindump and /ask-me draw the product out of you and file each piece where it belongs; /propose-idea is the one that puts an idea in, and only on your approval. Whatever you affirm, wherever you affirm it, formalize-ideas is the one rule set that decides where it lands and in what shape.
